Good straightforward yoga. This yoga walks through each pose in a simple, straightforward manner. You don't have to look at the screen to see how to do each pose, which is a big plus. Another great aspect is that while in each holding pose, she tells you what the pose is used for and what muscles should be engaged. 

 Like other commenters, I think the sun salutations are a little rushed. They also tell you to jump from forward fold to high plank, which can really really hurt your shoulders, elbows and wrists - I would suggest either floating from forward fold straight into your low plank to start your vinyasa or step back into high plank and then lower down to low plank into your vinyasa.

Also, the separate poses do not necessarily begin and end in the same position, so more often than not you are ending a pose standing and immediately starting a new one sitting. I would expect this to happen when I create custom workouts (which, for the record, is a nice touch), but it even has these choppy transitions in the regular routines. It is a little frustrating because it forces you to break your flow to scramble to the next pose.

Despite this, this app is one of the better ones I used and I'm happy to pay $3 dollars for what it delivers.

Simple & encouraging. Simple , clearly guided practice for beginners to more confident . Minimal understanding of the poses is required . 20 minutes at a time , one can build up a bit of confidence to increase to longer workout . Strongly recommend to those who want to get back into practising .

Best thing ever. This App has helped me in more ways than just working out, it has helped me connect to my inner self and dig up that real motivation, dedication and discipline for me to continue being in shape and loving myself. I've started doing 40 minutes everyday! 
Is there any chance you could adjust the 40+60 minute workouts because there’s way too many sun sulutations and I think it’s better if more exercises are to be included!

Need more variation. I love this app however I’m still level 1 and not ready to move to another level. It would be highly beneficial if the app changed the routines slightly every month to give new learning opportunities and build on our yoga personal development.
Great. Brilliant app for beginners. I’ve downloaded others but this is by far the easiest..

Great if you like one routine on repeat. Paid a fiver in the belief that I would get varied yoga workouts for the week. The reality is that the level 2 is identical to the level 1 and there is only one routine that I have now done four days on the bounce. Yes you can make your own routines from 60 or so moves but being a complete novice I have no idea which moves to include to make a decent session- was really expecting the app to do that for me. The instruction is good but only having one default workout makes it a complete waste of time and money- and ultimately very boring.

Best app ever. Cant praise this app enough ,working through 20 min apps ,i am on no2 and poses are held for longer slightly harder but getting easier now ,when i have completed all 20 mins i shall go on to the 40 min ones ,i do this daily and have been doing for about 6 months now and can really feel the difference in the core area ,its very clear and easy to follow with appropriate sea sounds ,have tried other apps but this is by far the best.

Just Yoga. Starting up a bit confusioning but when figured out is ok. Have only done stage 1, 20 minutes and 40 minutes. The stretches are getting easier as going along. In 40 minutes rather too many SUN SALUTATIONS. But otherwise finding it a good way to clear the mind before going to bed. 
Worth persisting with to get the strength and stretch going. Dont think will ever balance on one leg but trying. 
Altogether a good app. Trainer good with calming voice and I like the sea sounds.

Simple good app. I have used this app for a few years now for my personal practice, it's very simple and you can build your own practice if you pay for the full program. I like it and will continue to use it as well as attend my usual yoga classes.

Great for all yogi's, regardless of experience. I recently used this app whilst travelling Asia for 3 months.
The 20/40/60 minute practice options are a great addition.
Also, I found it very easy to build my own practices so each day was a new experience.
Since returning I stopped practicing completely for around 5 weeks, I'm easing myself back in with 2 weeks of level 1 and I look forward to each practice, great app!

reviews.text: Simply what I've needed. I have wanted to try yoga for years but never found a class that I enjoyed. I'm a bit self conscious. Simply Yoga is perfect. Have been doing it at home for a few weeks and very quickly became addicted. I am in control of how I practice. I am stronger, calmer and have good muscle tone. I've even now begun a meditation course. I feel amazing.

Great app. Been using this for nearly a year now, great pre-set sessions, quick and easy to do most days to keep up a routine. 
Would be good if it were easier to set your own sessions, e.g. Move things around more easily (rather than deleting everything you just entered) or just being able to edit more easily.
Excellent. Great ap

Excellent. I've been using this app for a few months now, the 20 min session is ideal in the mornings and IT WORKS... Feeling much more supple, toned, calmer & fitter. Tried level 2 but not quite ready for that yet ☺️ I'm 50 and intend to keep doing this for as long as my body will allow. 
Give it a go!

Too rushed. I’m a novice, been to yoga classes for 6 months and I couldn’t keep up with the different movements in the sun salutation. The pace is too quick, not enough emphasis on breathing, relaxation and pauses. Far too rushed for me.

reviews.text: Great value. Awesome, I had basic yoga knowledge before trying the ap. Give a great workout. A great product and can build your own routines to suit your needs.
Perfect. Brilliant app, works seamlessly. Great value at a couple of quid. Why not try a small enclosed room and a blow heater for a bikram type practice.
Instructive and challenging. Very clear, good workout lengths to fit around any schedule with varying levels of difficulty. Highly recommended

Highly recommended. I've been using this app in its original formal and the updated version for close to 4 years. You will find it hard to find a better yoga app than this. Even after using it for so long I'm still discovering and perfecting new tricks and poses. If you like your yoga at home on your own, this is the one

Yoga. Very good app. Iv compared about a dozen and this one def is best. It has video not just pictures, tells u when to breathe, is clear, and the poses are generic and good, not just stretches, but actual yoga poses. First app Iv purchased on iPad! So it's pretty good lol

An excellent, versatile yoga app. This app has really helped me get into yoga. I started as a beginner, using the free version of the app to do the 20 minute sessions. I found the variety of poses and times really good and loved the varying degrees of difficulty. My confidence in the poses grew and I soon found myself paying for the full version, which is something I very rarely do, however, I haven't regretted it. I've used the app continually for 18 months and it has served my varying needs. Longer times, the ability to create my own sessions with my preferred poses. Plus, when I travelled, I could design a session focused on standing poses as I didn't have my yoga mat with me. I recommend this app to anyone who is interested in starting yoga. Its videos and directions are clear, it has a range of sound options and is clear and easy to navigate.

Great App. I love this app. I try to do the 20 minute session in the mornings. Sets me up for the day. I needed to watch and listen a few times before attempting some of the moves but easy to pause and go back. I like the waves sound and the narrator has a lovely clear and calm voice.
Perfect bite size yoga. Cool app, simple short yoga sessions well explained - great to stretch at home or when travelling.

Disappointed.
Ms. Great app, perfect for a quick daily workout and a more challenging routine if you prefer. You can even create your own routine based on the poses you feel do the most good.

Amazing!!. This is great for anyone who doesn't have time for gym. It's easy to learn nothing is extremely difficult, this really does tone your body and loose weight if you do it everyday !! Have recommended family and friends to this they really enjoyed it.

Fantastic app. It's in the name... It's simple and it's yoga. Great instructional video for each work out. 2 different levels of difficulty, with 3 varying lengths for each - 20, 40 and 60mins. Would highly recommend this perfect simple yoga app.
Simple and accurate. One of the best to just follow a routine with simple and very accurate helpful voice instructions.

If you like simple effective, you will like this. I don't use a lot of yoga apps and I don't do a lot of yoga. So for me this really works like a yoga teacher, taking it nice and easy to follow.
The UI is not great, in fact a bit crappy. But there are no adverts, simple play and start and 2 levels to upgrade yourself to when you know the basics. Good thing is there is a real person doing it and no animation or picture presentation which for me has worked great. Oh and I like the soft sound of sea waves in the background.
Suggestion: improve the UI a bit but keep it simple. Great work!

Sun salutation. Annoying music, instructors voice is robotic and painful... As you increase the time all they do is add sun salutations with no added value. 

After 10 years of yoga instruction I've tried most apps and this by far is the worst.

Recommend. I don't usually leave reviews, in fact this is the first. Brilliant app, used the free version a few times and decided to buy the full app within a week! 

I live a very hectic life and my exercise routines leave me with short tight muscles. Great for short yoga routines, very clear instructions - I fully recommend!
Love this app. I don't generally buy apps, just enough content with free option but this has improved my flexibility and running no end, had to purchase full version! Fantastic app, well worth it!

Excellent way to exercise. Love this app. Good for you in so many ways. Physically and psychologically relaxing as well as toning the body. I have health problems and wanted something to help feel fitter without harming and that I could do at my own pace. This app is excellent and just what I wanted. Thanks for a great app.

Great. This app is great. It's easy to fit my yoga practise into a busy schedule and it's very informative on the positions and how to hold your body so it's easy to follow. I just wish it had a variety of different routines ready made for each level as it can get repetitive.
Great. Simple, easy and all at the right speed to complete the exercises. The first few times were really hard but the flexibility starts to kick in so it does what it's meant to do
Great app!. Love this app, instructions are clear, can use it anywhere and you can set reminders. Perfect for me!

Notice a difference in days. I've been using this app for a few weeks now and have noticed increased flexibility and less stiffness which is a great help as I'm I've 6ft6.
Variety in length of workout and clear instructions. I think I'll pay for the full app!
Love it!!. This is bar far the best yoga app I've found on any platform. It offers custom or pre-set sessions, and overall it is simple to use and very relaxing. Highly recommended.
Excellent yoga app. I use this every day fabulous I really recommend it

This is a great app can't recommend it highly enough!. The title says it all. I, like a previous reviewer, have just moved up to level two and am loving it. The instructor gives the just right amount of information. You can choose the length of routine that fits into the time you have available which is very handy. I look forward to doing the routines every day. Thank you whoever you are
 :-)
Love it!. Been practising yoga on and off for years. This app really helps me keep it up, especially love the 20 minute session. I use it after work to wind down.
Great app!. Really useful, I especially like the ability to create your own routines and save them. Very useful and clear
Jessie P. Lovely, I wanted to learn yoga for ages, but couldn't join a class as I care for my husband full time. This is ideal, easy to use and I love it.
Great. Learning yoga with this app is great! After a while you don't even have to look at the phone, just listen to her voice. I love it
Amazing!. I love this app so much! I can already feel a difference. It would be great to have an option for pronouncing the proper pose names instead, but other than that, great!
Fantastic. Excellent!!! I love it... Just what I was looking for.
Great App. Been using this app for about 3 weeks now, being in my 50's I have already noticed a difference in my flexibility and balance, after a 20 min class I feel great.
Great intro to yoga. Have been doing it for about a month and really enjoy it. Great for stretching, flexibility, relaxation and leaves me feeling energized. Thx.
Yoga. Wonderful way to start the day. Gets better each time
Very good app. Would love more varied workouts.. Very good. Thought the full version will have more varied workouts

The more I do it, the more I love it!. Great app, just moved on to level two twenty minutes and I feel great. I would like to know how the real names are pronounced although I like that they are written along side the English names. Definitely worth paying for.
Great Yoga App. Ideal for beginners or for those who can't make it to a class. Each pose is well described, making it easy to concentrate on the movement.
Simply Yoga. Good for home practise.
Great between classes. Excellent app for doing a daily session between classes. 20 min sessions very useful.

Excellent. Been using this app every day for just under a year and I feel much better for it .
It has taken me a while to graduate to the second 20 min routine but hope to get better, maybe a few more set out 20 min ones would be a good idea.
Brilliant. This is great. Simple instructions which are easy to follow.
Simply Yoga app. Excellent app. I do the routines every day and have seen a real difference in my flexibility and body toning. Highly recommended.
Great Introduction to Yoga. Great stuff. Poses are well explained for a beginner like me. An absolutely great starting point to get into Yoga!
Great App. I've just started using this and I'm really impressed, a good daily yoga workout.

A bit misleading. A good app to have but on paying £1.99 for the full version I was disappointed to find that level two contains the same exercises as level one! The ability to work for longer is good but to have two levels the same is a bit misleading and not good value for money!

Good app for beginners. I hadn't really done yoga before and found this a great way to start, especially as I work long hours and struggled to get to a class. The workouts are good and cover a rang of movements, the explanations of poses are clear and are backed up by demonstrations. It has a calming background soundtrack of waves crashing which I really like and colour bars to indicate how far you have got in the workout. There are 3 options of workout length, 20, 40 and 60 minutes, so easy to find a length to fit into your day. Highly recommended.
Good to strengthen. I have a lot of back problems and yoga has been recommended to me, this app explains how to do the poses for a beginner and it really clear and simple.
Excellent.. Like having your own personal guru in your pocket.

Excellent. Yoga poses are very well explained (pleasant voice) and illustrated. Have been using this app daily for several months, switching between 20 min and 40 min routines and different levels. Excellent app - many thanks!
Workout level 1. Very good simple workout just right to relax to.

Stretch out and chill out. Only takes a couple of times to practice some of the moves and you are soon doing a great yoga session with the help of the instructor. She helps with your breathing and talks you through the moves well. Great app.

Excellent!. Great yoga movements. Have had a sore back after running too much. This is a brilliant yoga programme with simple and effective movements that anyone could do. Would recommend to anyone- woman, man and no matter what age... Something everyone should do every day as its only 20 minutes of your day and a great investment to your body and future!
Simply Yoga. Good work out, with most benefit from taking the exercises but doing them slowly in a sustained manner. Removes tension in muscles after gardening etc.
Simply Yoga. Nice app, good way to unwind after work.

Yoga newbie.. Pretty good this! The basic app is peppered with stupid ads which are a pain. Yes, I'm in the middle of a relaxing yoga session but I'd like to play a mermaid game!? Gives simple instruction on positions and benefits. Update, chill out and get flexible!
